source_notes: 2027 Tokyo Graduate School of Science MEXT application page conflicts with general-category suspension notices from Keio and Waseda. Treat as unresolved institutional/track-specific issue, not evidence of global discontinuation.
UCLA IELTS 7.5 and TOEFL scores are admissions guidance, not scholarship eligibility thresholds.
St Andrews named award amounts differ; do not infer a universal amount for the generic record.
Keio and Waseda institutional grants are not automatically fully funded.
SAT not universally mandatory for Waseda English-based undergraduate programmes; alternate standardized qualifications accepted.
